sources.official: Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade
sources.methods: Output Lag trophy guide, launch week

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the whole list. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, the missable spots in their chapters, the counts last — and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
steps: Finish the story and every side strand
Clear the 100% checklist for A Long Road
Mop up the counting trophies last

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission and cannot be missed — play through the opening and the trophy pops at the end of it.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophies pop as you play; a chapter trophy can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so keep playing into Chapter 2 if it has not popped yet. Do Lucia's balcony meditation before this chapter ends — see Positive Mental Attitude.
steps: Finish Chapter 1
Do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. This is the chapter where Jason and Lucia can switch, so most of the list opens up from here — partner trophies, garages and the Scooter Bros app all unlock in this chapter.
steps: Finish Chapter 2

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears in this chapter — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks and shows an hourglass icon.
steps: Finish Chapter 3
Do Race Against Yago as soon as it appears

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Bank vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of this chapter — do it before the finale, and bring your partner.
steps: Finish Chapter 4
Do That's Where The Money Is before the finale

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, and that save is your only way back if you want to redo anything in the finale.
steps: Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Finish the mission Breakfast Run

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Finish the mission Child's Play

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Finish the mission Headliners

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the in-game checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, which only appears after the story. Work you do earlier still counts. The checklist is long, not hard: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, and the rest. Expect the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum to sit here.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the 100% checklist
Work the checklist in any order — earlier progress counts
Leave the big counts (300 stunts, 70 Challenges) for last

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist needs 300.
steps: Mix stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types across Leonida — dip into each one at least once and the trophy pops. You do not need to finish or win any of them.
steps: Try one of each of the 9 activity types

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them. Gold each challenge — the medal thresholds are the only bar.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges
Earn gold on all 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations — win at least one race at each. You do not need to win every race, just one per location.
steps: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; the 20 must be different races, so work through the race list rather than repeating one. Street races, including Yago's strand, all feed it.
steps: Win 20 different races across Leonida

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and beat his score in the challenge. Do it in Chapter 1 while you are learning the fishing activity.
steps: Find a fishing challenge against Cal
Beat his score

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and finish one game — any game, any score. It is one of the quickest trophies on the list.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Finish one arcade game

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — finish it whenever you like after the story.
steps: Follow Andy's questline to its final mission (Lucia-only)
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline stays available after the credits.
steps: Follow Kenton's questline to its final mission
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline stays available after the credits.
steps: Follow Billy's questline to its final mission
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — do it the moment it appears and save first.
steps: Finish stranger strands and watch the progress counter
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears
Skip Andy, Billy and Tyrone strands for this count — they have their own trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's questline stays available after the credits.
steps: Follow Randy's questline to its final mission
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and stays available after the credits.
steps: Follow Tyrone's questline to its final mission (Jason-only)
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears when the chapter ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The missable one is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen in the morning, follow Lucia out to the balcony and accept the optional task. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that spot, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (after Down to Earth, morning, kitchen, then balcony)
Meditate at every spot; bring your partner so each outdoor spot counts twice
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
steps: Follow Bret's hunting questline (Jason-only)
Hunt the unique animal — aim for a clean head or heart shot

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect the cards scattered across Leonida and finish any 3 full sets. Cards are a collectible like any other — sweep them as you explore.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida
Complete any 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to check in at 100 different spots across Leonida. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward discovering them for Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive.
steps: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50.
steps: Work the Challenges list under Progress, then Challenges
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest way is a bank vault job: vaults hand you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escape one with your partner and this pops with Maximum Withdrawal. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
steps: Bring your partner on a bank vault job (4 stars on entry)
Escape together until you leave the red heat zone

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop — give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
steps: Call your partner
Rob three shops in a row while the police chase you — do not let the stars fade
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the pop

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning past 100.
steps: Scan traffic with the WAiNK app as you drive
Keep going to 200 models for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
steps: Find a group of enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation
Aim and press L3 and R3 for Combat Focus
Down 5 with an assault rifle in the one use

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.
steps: Go to VCIA and take a large plane at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4)
Back out, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, on the far southwest island
Get into a tank on the south side and drive and fire until it pops

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) for the Snap Gun
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door
Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe, leave unseen

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away — escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is (Chapter 4)
Tail an armored van to a bank and enter the vault with your partner
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it, and escape the heat. Like the vault jobs, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone.
steps: Take an armored truck
Escape until you leave the red heat zone

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state — the game tracks which you have seen. Drive, fly and walk the map; remote corners count too.
steps: Visit all 52 areas across Leonida

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs — rob one illegal operation from each. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.
steps: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Metode belum terkonfirmasi. The official description is the only hint so far: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger at launch — it may pop while you play normally. This guide will not guess the spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Metode belum terkonfirmasi. The official description is the only hint so far: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger at launch.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt and Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 with Sticky Bombs
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents (Sticky Bomb the safe)
Escape the police

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Jason and Lucia should both reach maximum Strength — buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
steps: Buy a gym membership
Train with your partner until both reach maximum Strength

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play.
steps: Keep playing — robberies and fights feed the 500-action count

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Metode belum terkonfirmasi. The official description is the only hint so far: second time's the charm. No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger at launch — it may pop on a second attempt at something, but no source has confirmed what.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Metode belum terkonfirmasi. The official description is the only hint so far: what the hell just happened? No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger at launch — it may pop on a strange or random event while you play.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Metode belum terkonfirmasi. The official description is the only hint so far: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger at launch.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative.
steps: Collect marked bills from bank and payday loan jobs
Sell them to your contacts until $250,000 is laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — it adds up on its own as you buy weapons, clothes, food and cars.
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count. Buy garages before you register cars for On the Spot — each car needs a free garage space.
steps: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to unlock the Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages (about $160,000 total)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
steps: Finish Moses (Chapter 2) to open the Scooter Bros app
Take a stolen car to Moses, Respray, then Register — 10 times
From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray trackers also work
